mapping.summary: Finite-capacity resource scheduling and drag-and-drop Gantt for BC projects on Essentials.
claims: Constraint-solver scheduling that treats each person's capacity as a hard limit
Catches and resolves double-booking across projects
Each moved task shows why it moved
Accepted plan writes dates back to native job planning lines
Drag-and-drop Gantt with project and resource views, day-to-month zoom
All four dependency types with positive or negative lag
Skill-level matching restricts scheduling to qualified resources
Reusable project templates with tasks, dependencies and skills
Excel export and re-import of task changes
Runs on Essentials, no Premium needed
Scheduling service hosted by the publisher on Azure; data not retained
Planner seat $699 and read-only Viewer seat $199 per user per month
Twenty steps of undo and redo before saving
